Thursday, November 26, 2026. A little planning leaves more room for the fun.

NOV26
Thanksgiving morning, 2026

9 AM Mountain · Paul, Idaho

  1. 8:00 AM

    Check in at the gym

    Collect your race packet at West Minico Middle School. Arrive before the 9 AM start.

  2. 9:00 AM

    Find your pace

    The 5K run and walk starts on the school track, loops through the neighborhood, and returns to the track.

  3. ~10:30 AM

    Celebrate together

    Awards ceremony. This time is approximate and may vary.

West Minico Middle School

155 S 600 W, Paul, Idaho

  • Start and finishOn the school track.
  • ParkingUse school lots off 600 W. Accessible spaces are south of the gym; display your placard.
  • On the courseWater near mile 1.6, mile markers, and restrooms at the school and track.
